newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB DOWNGRADES MOL TO HOLD.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB DOWNGRADES MOL TO HOLD.

text.p: CS First Boston downgraded shares in Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt to 'hold' from 'buy' saying the stocks were overvalued.
"We are downgrading MOL from a buy to a hold," analyst Spencer Jakab said in a desknote.

"The shares have appreciated 92.2 percent this year and by 14 percent over the last week in US dollar terms, pushing it above what we consider to be an attractive valuation range relative to the European oil sector," he said.
He said that MOL's recent rally appeared to be based almost solely on technical rather than fundamental factors.
"In particular, MOL's rise is linked to its status as the most liquid and largest capitalisation stock in what is perceived as Central Europe's most attractive market," Jakab said.
At 1015 GMT MOL shares traded at 5,155 forints, down 60.
